messages:
Asha (Support): Heads up — AcmeCorp says their month-end invoice total doesn't match the dashboard. Invoice line 202 = 3,214,000 tokens vs dashboard ~2,913,000. Can someone take a quick look?

Riley (Billing): On it. Which invoice id?

Asha (Support): INV-2026-031. Quick note: dashboard sum by plan tier vs invoice looks like ~300k tokens moved from 'standard' into 'reserved-burst' on the invoice.

Jamal (SRE): Could be a backfill/replay. We had a retry window last night. Is there an ingestion job id?

Elena (CS): @Riley customer wants a clear breakdown — if mismatch >1% we escalate.

billing-bot: Backfill job started: backfill-2026-03-01T00:12:03Z (shard-7)

Riley (Billing): Running quick aggregate now, pasting query output:

```
SELECT plan, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'acmecorp' AND date >= '2026-02-01' AND date < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY plan;
-- results: standard: 2,913,112 ; reserved-burst: 300,888
```

Asha (Support): Invoice lines CSV (excerpt):

```
line_id,plan,tokens,invoice_amount
202,standard,2,613,112,1234.56
203,reserved-burst,600,888,234.00
```

Asha (Support): So invoice shows standard 2,613,112 and reserved-burst 600,888 — ~300k shifted.

Jamal (SRE): I'm seeing overlap on shard-7 between 2026-03-01T00:10 and 00:14 where backfill retried without idempotency key. The retry wrote events where plan was resolved from an older plan_history snapshot, causing some events to be tagged as reserved-burst instead of standard.

Riley (Billing): Is there an audit trail mapping event_id -> ingest_job? We should join invoice_line.event_ids to the ingestion log and confirm which job assigned the plan.

Asha (Support): Repro steps I'm using on the customer export: 1) dump dashboard raw events for acct 'acmecorp' for Feb window 2) group by event_id to get token counts 3) join invoice_line.event_ids from invoice export — that'll show duplicates/ownership. I can share the CSV.

Jamal (SRE): Mitigation idea: add a dedupe filter in the invoice pipeline for this billing window that excludes events written by a job marked as 'retry_without_idempotency' or where duplicate_count > 0. I'll run a dry-run diff to see impact.

billing-bot: Dry-run queued: dr-1712349999-01 (invoice-dryrun)
